scope: Original source, visible-range, value-preservation, fallback, frozen baseline and handoff checks; not full first-edition or independent/live acceptance

checks.name: Every S3 target and non-whitespace character has a complete visible-unit disposition, with explicit Spec scope
Every reviewed quote is re-extracted from pinned RSC bytes and the compiled index is reproducible
Nurse greeting, recovery explanation and question never expose later independent pages
Bookshelf heading and the two overlapping title windows select their actual original ranges
Battle menu cells and PP exclude palette, coordinate and unrelated-cell controls
Unidentified actors, unseen required rank and unlocated titles keep current Japanese
Unique original sources publish unchanged RSC wording despite localization or entity differences
Quantities, display numbers, prices, stats, trainer IDs and new current values are copied verbatim
No prefix, unknown glyph, wrong layout or unmatched window can acquire a translation
Cross-version witnesses are required and unapproved game conflicts cannot pick a first result
Changed original Chinese, invalid ranges, injected controls, duplicate rules and forged source identities are rejected
Frozen reference and evaluation manifests bind current sources, decisions and implementations without old model gold
Isolated S6 handoff loads original citations without upstream files or the reference
Repeated full actual-input evaluation reproduces the fixed baseline and all review data
